crosswalks.historical_boundary: Florentine Republic fiscal territory documented by the 1427-1429 Catasto; used only as an approximate ordinary rural validation footprint
crosswalks.resolution_method: Mapped the 23 non-city EU5 locations with area=tuscany_area and excluded the Florence city location. The Florentine contado and district boundaries are not recoverable as an exact polygon from the cited archival catalogue; no population or capacity aggregate is rescaled.

area_comparison.area_difference_policy: No population or capacity aggregate is area-rescaled; this crosswalk is validation-only.

current_frame_diagnostic.use: diagnostic only; no historical population or capacity target is emitted

crosswalks.notes: The Florence city location is explicitly excluded because the Catasto city record represents a trade hub with imported food and cannot supervise surrounding intrinsic land capacity.
